title: User creates password during registration
gherkin:
Feature: Password Policy Enforcement - Registration
  Scenario: User must create a password during registration
    Given a new user is on the registration page
    When the user submits the registration form without providing a password
    Then the system shall reject the registration
    And an error message shall indicate that a password is required
    When the user submits the registration form with a valid password
    Then the registration shall succeed
    And the user account shall be created with the provided password
rationale: Validates that the system enforces password creation as a mandatory step during user registration, ensuring all users have a password set upon account creation.
usedContextItems: The system shall require the user to create a password during registration

Feature: Password Policy Enforcement - Session Token Invalidation
  Scenario: Old session tokens are invalidated after password change
    Given an authenticated user with an active session token
    When the user successfully changes their password

    And any subsequent requests using the old session token shall be rejected
    And the user shall receive an authentication error
    When the user logs in with the new password
    Then a new session token shall be issued
    And the user shall be able to access protected resources with the new token
